summary: Iteration 3 — Razorpay billing module + UI overhaul (light/dark theme + PressScale animations) tested end-to-end. 13/13 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend /upgrade renders all 3 tier cards, period toggle, MOST POPULAR + SAVE 20% badges, payment chips, active trial banner with Cancel; Profile theme-toggle flips light↔dark theme correctly with AsyncStorage persistence. Feed/login flows still work. One minor visual glitch noted on the period toggle.

ui_bugs.issue: When Annual is active, the Monthly pill text appears to overlap with the Annual button + SAVE 20% inline pill, making the row look squished on a 390px viewport (the inline SAVE 20% badge inside the Annual flex:1 button pushes width beyond what the Monthly side allows). Visual only — taps still register and selection works correctly.

issues: Annual button width grows due to inline 'SAVE 20%' badge breaking equal-width assumption from `flex:1`. Consider moving the SAVE 20% badge to absolute position or rendering it outside the flex children so both pills stay equal width.

action_items: Optional: fix the period-toggle visual squish by absolute-positioning the SAVE 20% pill (e.g., position:absolute, right:8, top:-6 on the badge) so Monthly/Annual buttons render as equal-width halves.
When real Razorpay keys are added later, re-test /billing/create-subscription live path (short_url returned, subscription pending → active via webhook) and /billing/verify with valid HMAC.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1370 lines — consider splitting billing endpoints, social auth, and lead/AI logic into separate modules for maintainability.

create_subscription demo path sets is_premium=true but the legacy /auth/toggle-premium endpoint still exists; both paths can mutate is_premium independently which could confuse state. Suggest deprecating toggle-premium or routing it through the same plan_tier fields.
billing/webhook returns 200 even when user_id can't be resolved (silent drop). This is fine for Razorpay's retry semantics but worth logging warn-level when an event is dropped.
In get_user_limits, expert tier returns 100000 as 'unlimited' — fine for now but consider sentinel value (None or -1) and updating fetch_leads/generate-message to skip the cap entirely.
ThemeContext: setMode prop is exported but Profile only uses toggle; consider exporting only what's needed.
PressScale uses Animated.View with `flex:1` always — when wrapping fixed-size icons (e.g., back-btn 38x38) this is harmless but in row layouts it might unintentionally stretch.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all functional checks pass; 1 minor layout glitch on period toggle)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_billing_<uuid>@leadforge.io users via /api/auth/register inside test fixtures (module-scoped). Each test run creates 1-2 fresh users; existing test@leadforge.io user already on Professional Trial from prior smoke test was used for the Pro-trial limits assertion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay is in demo_mode (RAZORPAY_KEY_ID empty). All billing endpoints exercised through demo path: create-subscription returns demo_mode:true with demo_sub_<uuid> id; cancel works without calling Razorpay; verify returns 400 'Razorpay not configured'; webhook accepts events without signature when RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty. The existing test user is currently on Professional TRIAL — to test fresh subscription flow, use /api/auth/register to create a new user. Frontend testIDs verified: plan-minimum, plan-professional, plan-expert, period-monthly, period-annual, subscribe-btn, cancel-btn, back-btn, theme-toggle, upgrade-btn. Theme toggle persists to AsyncStorage key 'leadforge_theme'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found in iter3 scope. Period-toggle visual glitch RCA: the styles.periodBtn has flex:1 but the Annual button additionally contains an inline saveBadge child, which inflates its intrinsic content width and creates uneven distribution under narrow viewports. Fix: position the saveBadge absolutely (top:-6, right:8) instead of as a flex sibling.
